task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Take the black scanner in the left arm, pick the tea-box in the right arm, and scan the tea-box using the black scanner.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架左臂取黑色扫描仪，右臂拾取茶盒，用黑色扫描仪扫描茶盒。
